walk_findings.triage_note: render_dashboard_page loops recent items (publish and pending) and calls esc_url(get_edit_post_link($item->ID)). For a contributor, get_edit_post_link() returns null for items they do not own, so esc_url(null) raises a PHP 8.1+ deprecation, 5 lines per dashboard load (one per recent item). Reproduced by loading admin.php?page=roadmap-dashboard as qa_contrib at 08:10:52. Repo rule: a deprecation from our code on 8.1-8.5 is a bug.
walk_findings.expected: no PHP deprecation; items the user cannot edit are rendered without a link
walk_findings.actual: PHP Deprecated: ltrim(): Passing null to parameter #1 ($string) ... wp-includes/formatting.php line 4558, x5 per load, from includes/class-roadmap-settings.php ~line 395

walk_findings.triage_note: The Roadmap menu and dashboard use capability edit_posts, so any Contributor sees the pending-submissions notice, total counts and the titles of other users' pending suggestions in Recent Items (Smoke 1.8.2b offline idea was listed to qa_contrib minutes after qa_member_owner submitted it). Settings are correctly 403. This is an owner policy call (1.8.2 privacy theme); not a broken function.
walk_findings.expected: owner decision: either dashboard needs manage-level capability, or Recent Items excludes items the viewer cannot edit
walk_findings.actual: qa_contrib sees 'You have 7 pending submissions awaiting review' and titles of others' pending items

walk_findings.triage_note: List template groups are collapsed by default. The group header is a plain div (tabindex=-1, no role, no aria-expanded, Enter does nothing), so a keyboard-only user cannot expand a group and therefore can never reach any list item or its dialog. Mouse expand then works and the dialog behaves correctly. Source: vue-app/src/components/RoadmapList.vue (built into assets/js/roadmap-app.js).
walk_findings.expected: header is a button (or role=button, tabindex=0) with aria-expanded, toggled by Enter and Space
walk_findings.actual: div.roadmap-list-group-header tabindex=-1, role=null, aria-expanded=null; Enter on the focused header leaves the group display:none

walk_findings.triage_note: GeneratePress renders its right sidebar on the board page (page template default layout), shrinking the wrapper to 740 of 1425px at 1440. Reign (reign-sidebar-right, 811px), BuddyX (secondary, 848px) and BuddyX Pro (secondary, 978px) do the same. Astra shows no sidebar (1200px). It is each theme's default page layout for a shortcode page, which the plugin cannot control; an owner picks the full-width template. No overflow at any width.
walk_findings.expected: no sidebar on plugin pages for classic themes
walk_findings.actual: GeneratePress right-sidebar present on /poll-roadmap/ at 1440 (hidden at 390)

walk_findings.triage_note: Twenty Twenty-Five constrains the page content to 645px and Twenty Twenty-One to 610px at 1440, so the kanban board (121 items) is squeezed to about 45 percent of the 1425px parent. Not an overflow; theme content width. Listed so the owner knows the full-width page template is the fix.
walk_findings.actual: wrapper 645px (TT5) and 610px (TT21) inside a 1425px parent at 1440

walk_findings.triage_note: By design the down arrow only removes an existing upvote (single-vote.js lines 98-110; downvotes were removed in 1.8.0). With no vote, clicking it sends no request and gives no feedback, yet it is announced as 'Downvote this idea'. Low severity labelling and dead-UI issue. Up-arrow aria-pressed and count are correct.
walk_findings.expected: label and behaviour match (for example 'Remove your vote', disabled when no vote)
walk_findings.actual: aria-label 'Downvote this idea', aria-pressed always false, click with no vote does nothing
